summary: bible/geography.json LOC-hall-of-doors physical.climate says 'cool dream-air', but the source states the hall is very hot (ch002-p09). The long-hall environment card follows the source; geography.json was not edited.

source_evidence.quote: as the hall was very hot, she kept fanning herself all the time she went on talking

findings.environment_card_value: temperature: hot (bible/scenes/SCN-long-hall/environment.json, all states; carried into SCN-pool-of-tears as hot humid air over cool water, and SCN-little-door-passage hall end)
findings.impact: Downstream lighting, environment-concept and ambience read both files. A 'cool' hall would lose the sweat and fanning the source motivates, and the heat's link back to the waking July afternoon (ruling 5.2 A).
findings.proposed_fix: Change LOC-hall-of-doors physical.climate to 'hot, close, still dream-air (ch002-p09)'. LOC-ornamental-pool 'cool, still dream-water' can stay: it describes the water, not the air.

not_self_fixed: Per SOUL: conflicts are reported, not smoothed; geography.json is locked (Bible v1).
resolution: Ruled for the source (ch002-p09 'as the hall was very hot', non-inferred). Fixed in the locked bible under BIB-0025: geography.json LOC-hall-of-doors physical.climate = 'hot, close, still dream-air (ch002-p09 ...)'. LOC-ornamental-pool is unchanged (it describes water, not air). SCN-long-hall/environment.json already matches, so no Phase 3 edit is needed; the lighting agent is told to read the hall air as hot. p2-merge_check.py: all PASS.
